title: PuriPuly HTTP extension
description: Declarative custom HTTP translation API extension for PuriPuly. See docs/http-extensions.md in the repository for the full field reference. A declared secret must be referenced through a {{secret:<id>}} placeholder, and the URL must not contain placeholders or credentials.

id.description: Lowercase identifier, unique within the http_extensions directory.

name.description: Display name shown in the settings UI.

description.description: Optional description shown in the settings UI.

url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) endpoint. The request method is always POST. The URL must not contain credentials or {{placeholders}}.

headers.description: Static HTTP headers. These names are forbidden case-insensitively: connection, content-length, host, transfer-encoding.

query.description: Query parameters sent with every request.

type.description: json sends application/json, form sends application/x-www-form-urlencoded, none sends no body.

value.description: Body template. Required for json and form: json accepts any JSON value, form requires a string-to-string object. Forbidden when type is none.

type.description: json extracts the translation through a JSON Pointer; text uses the raw response body.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer selecting the translated string. Required for json responses, forbidden for text responses. Example: /responseData/translatedText.

id.description: Identifier referenced by {{secret:<id>}} placeholders. Must be unique across the extension.

label.description: Human-readable label shown as the credential input in the settings UI.

secrets.description: Credential declarations. Every declared secret must be used by a {{secret:<id>}} placeholder in headers, query, or body. Secret values are stored by the system credential store.

source.description: Maps PuriPuly source language codes to API language codes.

target.description: Maps PuriPuly target language codes to API language codes.

language_map.description: Optional language code remapping applied before the {{source_language}} and {{target_language}} placeholders are rendered.
